title: Alley Repair - Routine
description: Use this service request type to report alley conditions that are NOT hazardous, but still need repairs. Hazardous conditions could cause damage to a vehicle or bodily injury - please Call 3-1-1. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the nature of the problem?

branches.Ruts in alley: Show validation alert and inline guidance about ruts on pavement versus dirt

branches.Unpaved/unimproved: New Service Type Suggestion popup displayed only the current Alley Repair - Routine type; Keep Current allowed proceeding

observedQuestions.prompt: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.conditionalMessage: If ruts/damage is on the alley pavement, continue with SR. If ruts are in the dirt off the pavement - use Sanitation Property Damage - SAN

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a nonhazardous alley repair.
actions.why: Report a nonhazardous alley breakdown, rut in the paved alley, standing water, or pothole. The 311 request form asks whether the surface is asphalt, concrete, or unpaved; it says to continue with this request when ruts or damage are on the alley pavement.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Alley Repair - Routine" requests does not apply to hazardous conditions that could damage a vehicle or cause bodily injury, or to ruts in dirt off the pavement. If ruts are in dirt off the pavement and were caused by a Sanitation truck, then submit a "Sanitation Property Damage" 311 request instead. If the condition is hazardous, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Alley Repair - Routine"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Alley Repair - Routine"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for dirt-alley damage caused by a Sanitation truck.
actions.why: For ruts in dirt off the alley pavement when a Sanitation truck caused the property damage. The 311 request form for "Alley Repair - Routine" requests directs dirt ruts to Sanitation Property Damage, whose saved description limits it to damage caused by Sanitation trucks.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation Property Damage"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone for a hazardous alley condition.
actions.why: For a hazardous alley condition that could cause vehicle damage or bodily injury. The description for "Alley Repair - Routine" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs residents to call 311 for hazardous conditions.
